name: Linh Phuoc Pagoda
summary: Linh Phuoc is the mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, east of the centre, with a dragon and a tower built from recycled glass. Visit Lâm Đồng lists admission as free. Allow about 45 minutes. Hours are Check on arrival. The tourist train from Da Lat station is the paired ride.
getThere: Tourist train or road to Trai Mat
heroCaption: The mosaic facade at Linh Phuoc
body: The pagoda at Trai Mat is covered in mosaic, with a dragon and a tower that uses recycled glass. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism pairs it with the tourist train from Da Lat station. On site, allow about 45 minutes.

Visit Lâm Đồng lists the visit as free. Hours are Check on arrival. If the train was the reason you came to the station, take it. The road to Trai Mat is the other way. Neither ride has a printed minute count. Check on arrival.

figures.caption: The bell tower at Linh Phuoc
figures.alt: Bell tower of Linh Phuoc Pagoda at Trai Mat

gettingThere: Linh Phuoc is at Trai Mat, east of the centre. The tourist train from Da Lat Railway Station runs toward it. A taxi or motorbike uses the road. Minutes and the train fare are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Da Lat Railway Station
legs.body: Tourist train toward Trai Mat. Vietnam National Authority of Tourism names this pairing. The fare and the minutes are Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Xuan Huong Lake
legs.body: Taxi or motorbike by road to Trai Mat. Minutes and the fare are Check on arrival.
